about: VST parameter -> FM8E payload field plus measured transfer function. Each entry was validated by reconstructing stored bytes at nine sweep points (0..1 in eighths) and re-checked out of sample at v=0.9. Measurements only; no Native Instruments code or data.

encodings.f32: LE float32, value = a + b*v (quantised means the engine rounds it)
encodings.uN: LE integer of N*8 bits, round(a + b*v) mod 2^N
encodings.enumN: N distinct stored byte values; see values
